infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Eazi's Ride uses your location to offer nearby trips and share your location with your assigned passenger during a ride.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Eazi's Ride shares your location with your assigned passenger during an active trip, including when you use another app.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow Eazi's Ride to use your location for nearby ride requests and live trip tracking.
plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow Eazi's Ride to share your live location with your assigned passenger during an active trip, even when the app is in the background.

foregroundService.notificationTitle: Eazi's Ride trip tracking is active
foregroundService.notificationBody: Your location is shared with your assigned passenger during this trip.
